title: On Spreading the news through three villages
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：spread　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 spread 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the keeper ① spread the news through three villages on the same day, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② spreads the news through three villages before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ spread the news through three villages at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ spread the news through three villages before — a line in the calendar for January 1979 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Spreading the news through three villages on the same day, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ spread the cloth across the whole table before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Spread the cloth across the whole table at once and never mention it again.

By 1992 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ spreads the cloth across the whole table on the same day every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ spread the news through three villages again when nobody else would.

⑩ To spread the news through three villages, my mother said in 1997, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody spreads the news through three villages before dawn again and somebody must spread the news through three villages on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 铺开（一般过去式 spread the news through three villages：1985 年守夜人头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 铺开（一般现在 spreads the news through three villages：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 铺开（不定式 to spread the news through three villages：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 铺开（过去完成时 had spread the news through three villages：1979 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 铺开（动名词 spreading the news through three villages 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 传播（spread the cloth across the whole table：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去传播把那块布铺满整张桌子）
G. v. 传播（spread the cloth across the whole table：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 铺开（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 spreads the cloth across the whole table，而母亲又一次 spread the news through three villages）

answers.why: spread 意为“铺开”，1985 年守夜人当天就铺开把这消息传遍三个村子，那是钟楼里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 spread。
spread 意为“铺开”，自那以后守夜人天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 spreads。
spread 意为“铺开”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯铺开把这消息传遍三个村子”，此处为不定式 to spread the news through three villages。
spread 意为“铺开”，年历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1992 年之前就有人铺开过，故用过去完成时 had spread。
spread 意为“铺开”，守夜人说“铺开把这消息传遍三个村子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 spreading the news through three villages 作主语。
spread 意为“传播”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去传播把那块布铺满整张桌子”，should ever 之后用原形 spread the cloth across the whole table。
spread 意为“传播”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻传播把那块布铺满整张桌子（spread the cloth across the whole table at once），以后再也不要提起。
spread 意为“铺开”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例传播把那块布铺满整张桌子，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 spreads。
spread 意为“铺开”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就铺开把这消息传遍三个村子，用一般过去式 spread 叙述。
spread 意为“铺开”，结尾那句是母亲 1997 年的话：要铺开把这消息传遍三个村子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和钟楼记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用

items: 1985 年，守夜人当天就铺开把这消息传遍三个村子；钟楼里每一个过路人都说这是头一回。（spread the news through three villages）
多年以后，守夜人仍天没亮就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（spreads the news through three villages）

守夜人说过，当天就铺开把这消息传遍三个村子这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（spreading the news through three villages 作主语）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 spread 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1985 the keeper spread the news through three villages on the same day, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper spreads the news through three villages before dawn whenever the tower asks.
Spreading the news through three villages on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever spread the cloth across the whole table before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower spreads the cloth across the whole table on the same day every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother spread the news through three villages again, and the tower remembered that half.
